# LakazAgri
> Offline-first Android app for farm-to-buyer coordination. Accountability is a Hyperledger Fabric verification of the batch. Launch countries: South Africa, Zambia, Tanzania, Mozambique (Southern Africa / SADC first); other Sub-Saharan countries can register.

## Positioning
LakazAgri targets agri-food systems across Sub-Saharan Africa - smallholder farmers, cooperatives, hotels, markets, traders and institutions. Southern Africa (SADC) is the first focus: South Africa, Zambia, Tanzania and Mozambique.

## Product (built, demo on request)
- Farmers post crop availability; buyers post demand; verifiers browse read-only
- Trust / order record: origin and batch ID, quality photos (offline), payment status and receipt proof
- Accountability check: Hyperledger Fabric verification of that batch. The public network is not left open for self-serve installs.
- Country groups keep posts together
- Languages: English, French, Portuguese (Swahili in progress)
- Payments are not processed in the app; users can record a mobile-money receipt (M-Pesa, Airtel Money, MTN MoMo, EcoCash) or bank slip as proof
- Offline-first cache on Android
- The shared cloud is switched on for a scheduled demo, not left running for self-serve installs
